The `⋯` menu arrangement is right and keeps each card much cleaner.

Showing a short note preview inline is useful, and searching it alongside the other bookmark text is exactly what I want. Three lines is a sensible preview, but I also need a way to expand or open the full note without entering edit mode.

I’d like notes to support simple Markdown—links, emphasis, headings, and lists—and display that formatting when I view the note. The editor can continue showing the Markdown text itself. Once the full, formatted note can be viewed, the notes flow is complete.
